provenance.researchDateBasis: Explicit access and check dates in sources.md and plan.html; historical publication/archive dates are not new research dates.
provenance.inspectionScope: Both source-run files read in full; full plan.html parsed using HTMLParser. Available run folder contains only plan.html and sources.md; no separately saved external pages/PDFs were available. No source builders/scripts executed.

datePolicy: All external accessDate values are reported by the inspected original source ledger as 2026-11-05, not verified network fetches in this adaptation. Distinguish publication 2026-10-28, historical archive snapshot 2026-09-02, announced/effective dates, and intake/deadline dates. Preserve original-run snapshot without new legal research.
uncertainties: Information only, not immigration or legal advice. Rule and fee statuses are attributed to the original 2026-11-05 run, not independently certified by localization.

Only Leeds Beckett shortlist tuition is course-specific 2027/28; Wrexham, Teesside and Derby earlier-year figures are not September 2027 quotations. Derby general 2027/28 fee is not course confirmation. Equivalence, intake, English and offers remain subject to university decisions.

Living proxy, ancillary allowances, reserve and hypothetical tuition uplift are estimates, not city surveys or supplier quotes. No NGN/GBP rate, earnings or unawarded scholarship is assumed. Graduate costs and family relocation excluded.

Forthcoming maintenance change is distinguished from snapshot in-force rates. Graduate eighteen-month published-rule assumption is distinct from Budget announcement; no qualifying-university list or operative/transitional terms established. Future rules/fees need refresh.

Chevening and agency-nominated Commonwealth rounds are closed in the snapshot; Shared Data Science course eligibility was not established. Lincoln/Northumbria awards are additional conditional options, not shortlist discounts; university award stacking is disallowed and return-home/sponsor-consent terms may conflict with post-study work.

No raw external source pages/PDFs were retained in the available source folder; source-specific reported dates and terms come from inspected plan.html/sources.md, not independent external verification. Original authoring model unknown.
editingContract: Readable English and Simplified Chinese retain corresponding-line and table-cell numeric/currency/date/URL parity. Local draft only; no stars, Review markup, website integration, shared registry or build changes.
